Real-Time Face Recognition Attendance System for Amazon Store (CCTV
Integration)
Developed a real-time face recognition system integrated with CCTV
cameras for an Amazon retail store to automate employee attendance and
detect unauthorized individuals. The system uses YOLOv11 for high-
accuracy person and face detection in live video streams, and FCENet for
reliable face recognition against a registered employee database. Built using
the Flask framework, the backend handles secure data processing, face
matching, attendance logging, and real-time alerts for unknown individuals.
